Geometric k-means cap on a cell set

Source: R/fn_patches.R
kcap.Rd

Split a set of cells into ceil(n / capn) compact pieces, each at or below capn cells, by k-means on cell (col, row) positions; k is bumped up until no cluster exceeds the cap (k-means targets equal sizes but does not bound them). Sets under the cap pass through as a single piece.

Usage

kcap(gc, capn, nc)

Arguments

gc

Integer vector of global (1-based) cell indices.

capn

Maximum pieces size in cells.

nc

Number of columns in the parent raster (to recover col/row from gc).

Value

Integer cluster label per cell (all 1L when n <= capn).
